title: Teams: allow list for external meeting notetaker bots
summary: Roadmap item 580451 (in development, GA targeted for January 2027) adds a tenant control for external meeting bots: admins will be able to list the external bots allowed to join meetings hosted in the organisation, and either block all others or send them to the existing high-friction lobby. Allowed bots are treated as ordinary external participants, so your meeting policies still apply to them.
why: Third-party AI notetakers joining meetings and sending transcripts outside the tenant are a data-protection and DLP problem today, and the current lobby-based bot detection is all-or-nothing. An allow list lets you approve the one vendor that passed review and block the rest.
todo: Do now: inventory which external notetakers actually join your meetings (meeting attendance reports, user reports) and decide which, if any, you would approve.
Write the approval criteria (data residency, retention, DPA) before the setting arrives, so the allow list reflects a decision rather than whatever users already use.
Wait: roadmap only; no PowerShell or admin centre setting is documented yet. Not verified.
effective_note: Roadmap 580451, in development, GA January 2027 — per Microsoft. Not verified.
